title: Butter chicken with spinach over rice

source.name: Feel Good Foodie: Easy Butter Chicken

protein: about 40g+ per adult portion, about 3g sugar
equipment: Large deep skillet or Dutch oven
ingredients: 3 lb chicken breast, cut in 3/4 inch chunks
1 1/2 tbsp butter and 1 1/2 tbsp olive oil
1 1/2 tsp each: chili powder, ground coriander, curry powder
3/4 of a 6 oz can tomato paste
1 1/2 to 2 cans (14 oz) coconut milk (use both for a saucier dish)
steps: Melt the butter with the oil in a large deep skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the onion until soft, about 5 minutes, then add the ginger and garlic for a minute.
Stir in the garam masala, chili powder, coriander and curry powder and toast for about 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the chicken, tomato paste, curry paste, salt and pepper and stir until the chicken is coated.
Pour in the coconut milk, bring to a boil, then turn down and simmer uncovered about 20 minutes, until the chicken is cooked and the sauce thickens.
Stir in the spinach a handful at a time until wilted. Serve over rice with cilantro.
changes: 3 lb chicken instead of 2 and the sauce scaled 1.5x, so an adult portion hits 40g+ protein.
Baby spinach stirred in so it's a complete meal.
